title: Hironaka Geometry and Resurgence in Finite-$N$ Matrix Models
summary: We study how finite-$N$ invariant theory organizes the non-perturbative structure of matrix models. For a model of four traceless Hermitian $2\times 2$ matrices, the Hironaka decomposition realizes the gauge-invariant configuration space as an eight-sheeted branched cover of the space of primary invariants. We show that ramification points of this cover naturally generate additional saddle points when the action depends only on the primaries.
